Core boxes: InMemoryStore (CRUD), ApiRouter (express.Router wiring), Controllers (resource handlers), Validation (input shapes), ErrorHandling (standardized errors), Logging (request/response logs), HealthCheck, Tests (Jest suite with 80%+ coverage), and Deployment artifacts (Dockerfile, npm scripts, CI).   "code": "/* index.js */\nimport express from 'express';\nimport helmet from 'helmet';\nimport { createStore } from './store.js';\nimport apiRouter from './routes/api.js';\n\nconst app = express();\nconst PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;\n\napp.use(helmet());\napp.use(express.json());\n\nconst store = createStore();\n\napp.use('/api', apiRouter(store));\n\napp.get('/health', (req, res) => res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: Date.now() }));\n\n// Global error handler\napp.use((err, req, res, next) => {\n  const status = err?.status || 500;\n  res.status(status).json({ error: err.message || 'Internal Server Error' });\n});\n\napp.listen(PORT, () => {\n  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`);\n});\n\n/* src/store.js */\nexport function createStore() {\n  const items = new Map();\n  let idCounter = 1;\n  return {\n    list() { return Array.from(items.values()); },\n    get(id) { return items.get(id); },\n    create(data) {\n      const id = String(idCounter++);\n      const entity = { id, ...data };\n      items.set(id, entity);\n      return entity;\n    },\n    update(id, data) {\n      if (!items.has(id)) throw new Error('Not Found');\n      const updated = { ...items.get(id), ...data };\n      items.set(id, updated);\n      return updated;\n    },\n    delete(id) {\n      if (!items.has(id)) throw new Error('Not Found');\n      items.delete(id);\n      return true;\n    }\n  };\n}\n\n/* src/routes/api.js */\nimport express from 'express';\nexport default function buildApiRouter(store) {\n  const router = express.Router();\n  router.get('/items', (req, res) => res.json(store.list()));\n  router.post('/items', (req, res) => {\n    const item = store.create(req.body);\n    res.status(201).json(item);\n  });\n  router.get('/items/:id', (req, res) => {\n    const item = store.get(req.params.id);\n    if (!item) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not Found' });\n    res.json(item);\n  });\n  router.put('/items/:id', (req, res) => {\n    try {\n      const updated = store.update(req.params.id, req.body);\n      res.json(updated);\n    } catch (e) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: e.message });\n    }\n  });\n  router.delete('/items/:id', (req, res) => {\n    try {\n      store.delete(req.params.id);\n      res.status(204).end();\n    } catch (e) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: e.message });\n    }\n  });\n  return router;\n}\n",

FEATURE SPECIFICATION:
Create a Todo API with the following endpoints:

1. GET /api/todos - List all todos
2. GET /api/todos/:id - Get single todo
3. POST /api/todos - Create todo (body: {title, description})
4. PUT /api/todos/:id - Update todo
5. DELETE /api/todos/:id - Delete todo

Requirements:
- Input validation (title required, max 200 chars)
- Proper HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 500)
- Error handling middleware
- Request logging
- CORS enabled
- Each endpoint fully tested

Create BoxSpecs for each component/module needed. Each box should:
1. Have a single, clear responsibility
2. Define input/output schemas
3. List dependencies on other boxes
4. Include acceptance test descriptions
5. Follow the ProjectContract constraints (javascript, esm, etc.)

Think through the architecture:
- Core services/utilities first
- Data layer (repositories, models)
- Business logic layer (services)
- API/interface layer (routes, controllers)
- UI components (if applicable)
- Testing utilities
